Jazz - From Bach To Brubeck to The Beatles
description: Arts@Peace of Peace Lutheran Church will be jazzing it up with a special Jazz concert for the community featuring, From Bach to Brubeck to The Beatles with the Jim Martinez Trio. Not only Jazz aficionados will be excited to experience Jim Martinez in person. Sacramento-based Martinez has performed around the world, sometimes performing and recording with other jazz greats. He was the pianist and musical director for both Joan Rivers and Bob Newhart at Harrah’s Lake Tahoe. Martinez has 13 CD’s to his name and has performed annually with symphony orchestras across the United States his jazzy “A Charlie Brown Christmas.”

Playwriting Group
description: All playwrights welcome! Whether playwriting is new to you or you're already an accomplished playwright, come join this on-going bi-weekly writers' group. We'll spend our time focusing on our writing, but with that magical element of doing so within the presence of others. Come discover the amazing experience of writing within the context of a group. Bring your computer, notebook, iPad, or whatever you like to use for writing. We share resources, discuss our goals and challenges, even provide feedback, but the primary focus of the group is to work on your own play! We'll do a check-in/discussion at the beginning of the meeting, then write in silence, and check-out at the end of our session. Contact Kimberly for the location and to answer any questions you may have. Category: Literary / Poetry / Author Event, Theater

Muse Lab - A Generative Writing Group + Open Mic
description: Muse Lab - A Generative Writing Group + Open Mic Muse Lab is a monthly, all-ages experiment in writing, attention, music, performance and the unknown. Through guided writing sprints, self-inquiry, strange questions, and creative prompts, we use writing as a tool for discovery - to witness what's here, explore what's hidden, and conjure things we didn't know were there. Music moves beneath the experience as we follow the thread and see what emerges.
